response.justification: Bogdan brings deep, broad hands-on engineering experience (~15 years across web, mobile, embedded, high-throughput backend systems) and demonstrated entrepreneurial drive via founding GISCollective, which partially satisfies the tenure and builder-fluency criteria. However, the role is a director-level IC focused on AI strategy, requiring recognized AI expertise, shipped AI products or platforms, deep cloud-platform vision, and experience advising strategic customers and executives. The resume shows only recent, peripheral AI exposure (MCP tooling and agent infrastructure at re:cinq), modest cloud depth (AWS CDK, Kubernetes deployment), and no evidence of strategic advisory, org-level influence, or an AI-related advanced degree. Title trajectory (Senior/Staff SWE) is also a level or two below the target.
strengths: ~15 years of hands-on engineering across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency distributed systems
Founder of an open-source geo-data platform plus active OSS tooling — genuine builder and entrepreneurial track record
Strong community presence: conference talks, multi-day workshops, and courses show ability to teach and inspire
concerns: Minimal demonstrated AI/ML expertise — no shipped AI products, models, or platforms at scale
Limited cloud-platform depth and no evidence of strategic customer/partner advisory or executive-level influence
Career level (Senior/Staff IC) is below the director-level principal scope; no Master's/PhD in an AI field

key_factors.factor: Seniority/scope below director-level IC strategy role
Long, broad hands-on engineering tenure and founder experience
